name: auth-card-demo
title: AuthCard and AuthLayout examples
description: Usage examples for AuthCard and AuthLayout.

files.content: # AuthCard and AuthLayout examples The sign-in card: a solid card on a deep field, with a logo slot, icon tile, title, footer strip and back link. ```tsx import { AuthCard, AuthLayout } from "@/components/shell/AuthCard"; } title="Sign in" subtitle="Use the email you signed up with."> …form… ``` ## Sign in with multi-factor authentication A brand bar in the header, the card centred, the security note in the footer. Switch between the password, MFA code and authenticator setup steps. ```tsx } footer={<> Protected by multi-factor authentication.} > } title="Sign in" subtitle="Use your work email."> ``` ## MFA code step ```tsx } title="Enter your code" subtitle="Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code."> ``` ## Authenticator setup step ```tsx } title="Set up your authenticator"> {secret} ``` Docs: https://rime.mjsons.net/components/auth-card
